<style>
/* ==========================================================
   BOTANICAL SMART GREENHOUSE DASHBOARD THEME (G3B)
========================================================== */
body.nr-dashboard-theme {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #edf7f1 0%, #f3f8fc 50%, #ebf5ef 100%) !important;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", "Prompt", "Noto Sans Thai", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif !important;
    color: #0f172a !important;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

body.nr-dashboard-theme md-content,
body.nr-dashboard-theme #nr-dashboard-content {
    background: transparent !important;
}

/* ===== TOP TOOLBAR ===== */
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-toolbar {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0f5132 0%, #15803d 55%, #0d9488 100%) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(15, 81, 50, 0.22) !important;
}

body.nr-dashboard-theme md-toolbar h1,
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-toolbar .md-toolbar-tools {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ===== GROUP CARDS ===== */
.nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
    background: transparent !important;
    padding: 8px 6px !important;
}

.nr-dashboard-cardpanel {
    background: #ffffff !important;
    border-radius: 18px !important;
    border: 1px solid #d1e7dd !important;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(15, 81, 50, 0.08) !important;
    padding: 6px 10px 10px 10px !important;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: box-shadow 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
}

.nr-dashboard-cardpanel:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15, 81, 50, 0.13) !important;
}

.nr-dashboard-cardpanel > p {
    color: #0f5132 !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    padding: 8px 6px 8px 6px !important;
    margin: 0 4px 8px 4px !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e6f2eb !important;
}

/* ===== GAUGES ===== */
.nr-dashboard-gauge {
    background: #ffffff !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
}

.nr-dashboard-gauge text {
    fill: #1e293b !important;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", "Prompt", system-ui, sans-serif !important;
}

/* ===== AI PREDICTED STATE CARD ===== */
.gh-predicted-card {
    background: #f8fafc !important;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
    padding: 0 16px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gh-predicted-card .label {
    color: #334155 !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
}

.gh-state-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 7px 20px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    min-width: 116px;
    text-align: center;
    transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.gh-state-normal {
    background: #dcfce7;
    color: #166534;
    border: 1.5px solid #22c55e;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.22);
}

.gh-state-alert {
    background: #fef3c7;
    color: #92400e;
    border: 1.5px solid #f59e0b;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25);
}

.gh-state-alarm {
    background: #fee2e2;
    color: #991b1b;
    border: 1.5px solid #ef4444;
    animation: gh-alarm-pulse 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
}

.gh-state-idle {
    background: #f1f5f9;
    color: #475569;
    border: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1;
}

@keyframes gh-alarm-pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.42); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0); }
}

/* ===== AI CONFIDENCE & TIMESTAMP WIDGET ===== */
.gh-confidence-card {
    background: #f8fafc !important;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
    padding: 8px 14px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.gh-conf-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 5px;
}

.gh-conf-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.gh-conf-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.6px;
    color: #64748b;
}

.gh-ts-badge {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #0f5132;
    background: #dcfce7;
    border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
    padding: 1px 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-family: "Consolas", "Courier New", monospace;
}

.gh-bars {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.gh-bar-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.gh-bar-lbl {
    width: 48px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #334155;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gh-bar-track {
    flex: 1;
    height: 8px;
    background: #e2e8f0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.gh-bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    transition: width 0.35s ease;
}

.gh-fill-normal { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22c55e, #10b981); }
.gh-fill-alert  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fbbf24, #f59e0b); }
.gh-fill-alarm  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f87171, #ef4444); }

.gh-bar-pct {
    width: 46px;
    text-align: right;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1e293b;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ===== LED PILL ROWS ===== */
.nr-dashboard-template:not(.gh-confidence-card) {
    background: transparent !important;
}

.nr-dashboard-template:not(.gh-confidence-card) .control {
    background: #f8fafc !important;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    padding: 0 12px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.nr-dashboard-template:not(.gh-confidence-card) .control > span.name {
    color: #1e293b !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
}

/* ===== RESET BUTTON ===== */
.gh-reset-btn button {
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.6px !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.24) !important;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease !important;
}

.gh-reset-btn button:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.34) !important;
}

/* ===== CHARTS ===== */
.nr-dashboard-chart {
    background: #ffffff !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    padding: 4px 6px !important;
}

.nr-dashboard-chart-title {
    color: #0f172a !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}
</style>
